messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: how to test multivariate normal distribution of the data?
parts:
Why would you want to test multivariate normality of the observed variables? SEM don't assume that the variables are normal, just that the residuals are multivariate normal. For path analysis models this is easy to test after fitting your model by building up the expected values and their observed residuals, but for SEMs with latent variables this becomes a bit more tricky.

Phil
